features: 450 Watts Powerful Sound: Experience 450 watts of clear and impactful audio that fills your room with richness, clarity and balanced loudness for movies, music and sports.

5.1 Channel Surround Sound: Step into immersive audio with a full 5.1 channel system. It includes a soundbar with 3 in-built full-range speakers, 2 satellite speakers and an external subwoofer for deep bass and detailed sound delivery. The subwoofer and satellites are wired for stable, high-quality output.

Nex SurroundFeel Technology: Nex SurroundFeel enhances directionality, channel separation and audio movement across all 5.1 channels. This creates a dynamic and engaging surround sound experience that feels more spacious and lifelike.

Mivi Signature Sound Crafted with Mivi’s proprietary tuning philosophy for balanced frequencies, clear vocals, detailed midrange and refined bass. Every note stays clean and natural across all types of content.
Multiple Input Modes Connect effortlessly using USB, HDMI ARC, Optical or AUX. For wireless pairing, use Bluetooth v5.3 for a smooth and stable connection.
